notes.body:
Whole-body PBPK model of ICG
Description
Model for whole-body distribution and elimination of indocyanine green encoded in SBML format.
Assumptions:
indocyanine green is confined to the plasma (no distribution into the tissues); the convective transport is the plasma flow, the blood flow times (1 - HCT)
indocyanine green is not metabolized; it is taken up by the liver and excreted unchanged into bile
The content of this model has been carefully created in a manual research effort.

Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3 (SLCO1B3). Often referred to as OATP1B3. Bilirubin effect was modeled as competitive inhibition.

Sinusoidal efflux of indocyanine green from the hepatocytes into the plasma (the bidirectional transport of the OATPs, MRP3 (ABCC3)), first order in the hepatic amount. It is the slow secondary phase of the plasma curve after a bolus (Meijer1988: half-life 63 - 89 min).
Canalicular export of indocyanine green by the multidrug resistance associated protein 2, MRP2 (ABCC2), saturable.
The transit of bile from the canaliculi through the bile ducts, first order in the amount in bile, i.e. the excretion of indocyanine green with the bile; as simplification directly into the feces.
